description: Centrifuge Modeling of the Slope Stability, Run-out Behavior and Static Liquefaction of Fly Ash Deposits subjected to a loss of Confinement is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Srikanth Madabhushi S C, University of Colorado Boulder (colorado.edu). Numerous industries are concerned by the humanitarian, environmental, and economic consequences of debris flows, landslides and material run-outs. However, the run-out behavior following a loss of confinement e.g., dam failure, is not well understood. The material’s complex constitutive behavior means multiple mechanisms contribute to the deformation e.g., slope instability, seepage forces, erosion or static liquefaction. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Centrifuge Modeling, Fly Ash, Landslides, Static Liquefaction. Published 2023-05-31. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
